D001-D013 are verified perfect in Expose I; D014-D026 are verified perfect in Expose III through the end of section 2. Type-B/source-or-editorial conventions, diagram-index page drift, and the open R^!f / R f^! notation-normalization item remain documented risks.

The companion AGENT_SCORECARD.md remains useful as a finder-performance log, but its diagram tally can lag the live CERT_LOG; the controlling lesson is that agents/workflows are useful finders with incomplete recall, not certifiers.

The p69 log also clarifies scope: the source scan is the full 484-page LNM 589, but the local TeX is a curated 10-expose selection (I, III, IIIB, V, VI, VII, VIII, X, XII, XV). The p1-p88 certification is opening-range evidence, not global SGA5 certification.

This is still a live workpass, not an independently packaged or promoted edition. It has not yet received final diff/FINDINGS refresh, compact publication packaging, independent validation, optional prose-fidelity review, or English synchronization.
